name: Combobox
purpose: A text input that filters a list of options as the user types, and commits one of them. Use it instead of Dropdown when the option set is long enough that typing beats scrolling — countries, payees, currencies, branches. The value always comes from the list: free text is not accepted.
$provenance-note: NEW at #203 (wave 3b, lane J) against itinerary row 21 (P2, 'Type-ahead select'). Verified absent first-hand before building: ls knowledge/snippets/ | grep -i combo → nothing; ls knowledge/components/ → no combobox/autocomplete/typeahead meta; grep -rn 'aria-autocomplete' knowledge/snippets/ → 0 hits. The gated Dropdown carries role="combobox" on a BUTTON trigger, which is the select pattern, not this one.

props.name: fieldStyle
props.$note: Both gated field styles are supported so a form need not change its field style to gain a combobox. Matches Dropdown, which also keeps both.

props.name: state
props.$note: Same state channel as Input-fields/Textarea — inherited, not re-specified.

props.name: open
props.$note: Behavioural/content-presence state, no token consequence (the s142-D1 class C9 shape).

props.name: matchEmphasis
props.$status: PROPOSED #203, Dave's eye owed — how the matched run is marked. Underline was chosen because weight needs a raw font-weight declaration (TYPE-002 forbids it; there is no .t-cm-* emphasis hook) and colour alone is barred by 1.4.1 and by the red/yellow caution.

variants.name: boxed
variants.use: Full-border field — the default, matching the boxed Input field.

variants.name: underline
variants.use: Bottom-stroke field — for forms already built on the underline style.

tokens.field-border: form/border/default; focus-within form/border/active + a 4px inset bottom stroke; disabled form/border/disabled; error a 4px inset rag/error stroke (dark: full rag/error border, the Input-fields rule Dave set 2026-07-02)
tokens.menu-elevation: light elevation/functional (0 0 16px shadow); dark elevation/border (grey outline — shadows are invisible on a near-black page)
tokens.option-highlight: form/background/hover fill PLUS a 3px inset rule in form/border/active, so the active row is never colour-alone
tokens.shape: border-radius/control (field, toggle) and border-radius/surface (floating menu) — the Dropdown split, per-element judgment under ADR-0010
tokens.hit-area: target/min (44px) on the field row, the disclosure toggle and every option row

accessibility.roles: input[role=combobox] + aria-autocomplete="list" + aria-expanded + aria-controls; the popup is role=listbox with role=option children carrying aria-selected. The highlight is aria-activedescendant, so focus never leaves the input.
accessibility.keyboard: Down opens and highlights the first match; Up/Down move the highlight; Enter commits the highlighted option; Escape closes and keeps the typed text; Tab closes and leaves.
accessibility.announcements: A polite live region announces the number of matches after each keystroke, and the chosen value on commit. Without it the filtering is invisible to a screen-reader user.
accessibility.states: Disabled and error are exposed programmatically (disabled, aria-invalid + aria-describedby). Error is never carried by the red stroke alone — the message pairs a symbol with words and stays ink.
accessibility.targetArea: Field row, disclosure toggle and option rows are all 44px (target/min).

antiPatterns: Accepting free text. If the user may type a value that is not in the list, that is a different contract (aria-autocomplete="both") or it is Tags-input — do not quietly widen this one.
Marking the matched run with colour or weight alone. Colour fails 1.4.1 and red/yellow are problem hues here; weight would require a raw font declaration TYPE-002 forbids.
Moving DOM focus into the listbox. The input keeps focus; the highlight travels via aria-activedescendant, or the user cannot keep typing.
Filtering silently. Without the polite count announcement a screen-reader user cannot tell the list narrowed.
Using this where the option set is short and browsable — that is the gated Dropdown, and a text field there is friction, not help.
